'''Brentaal spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]]. [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]] watched [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] arrive and depart from the spaceport as a child; at the age of twelve, she stowed away aboard a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liner]].
